label: Claude's uncached live path is p50 172, p90 348, p95 618, max 1,538 ms over 529 rows; the cached path is p50 30, p95 151, max 913 over 926 rows.
A Claude prompt runs five Node processes: three UserPromptSubmit commands each with timeout 3, then the advisor hook and CLI inside the shim.
At the committed 36.85 ms bare-Node start, the advisor's three starts are about 111 ms, 64 percent of the 172 ms uncached median; collapsing two spawns would recover about 74 ms, 43 percent.
The health record cannot price the whole prompt: spec-gate-classify and context-nudge run outside the advisor leg and no record sums them.
What would confirm the ceiling: one probe running the three configured hooks in host order, recording per-command and total wall time.
